worldcombat.skill.dynamicpunch.summary: A full-power roundhouse: it sweeps a fan in front, every enemy inside takes a blow and is always left confused, stepping out of the fan avoids it, and whiffing leaves the user overextended.
worldcombat.skill.dynamicpunch.descripti: Swing a fan-shaped roundhouse: every enemy caught in it takes one hit for about %1$s contact and punch damage; the fan spans %2$s degrees over a %3$s block reach.

Anyone swept is always left confused for %1$s: while confused, every attempt to use a move or strike has a %2$s chance to fail outright and waste that attempt; a confused creature that hits a non-ally also hurts itself based on its Attack, but the self-damage never exceeds the damage that blow actually dealt.
If nothing is swept, the user cannot recover the swing and wastes a further %1$s s before acting again.
Reckless form: more power, a wider fan and a longer confusion, but a longer wind-up, recovery and cooldown, and a longer overextend on a whiff.
Controlled form: a shorter wind-up, recovery and cooldown and a lighter overextend, at the cost of a lighter blow, a narrower fan and a shorter confusion.
worldcombat.skill.dynamicpunch.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.dynamicpunch.growth.0: From level %1$s the roundhouse power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.dynamicpunch.growth.1: From level %1$s the roundhouse power rises to %2$s and the confusion to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.dynamicpunch.use.0: Sweep a fan at point-blank range to force the target to step out
worldcombat.skill.dynamicpunch.use.1: Daze a target on a hit to open a miss window for allies
worldcombat.skill.dynamicpunch.use.2: Gamble a heavy blow on a cornered, low-health target
worldcombat.skill.dynamicpunch.preferenc: On: more power, a wider fan and a longer confusion, but a longer wind-up, recovery and cooldown, and a longer overextend on a whiff. Off: more control and a shorter cycle, at the cost of a lighter blow, a narrower fan and a shorter confusion.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger starts swings sooner, and is easier to whiff.
On: when a wall or obstacle is right behind the target so it cannot step out of the fan, the user swings on it first (it almost always connects). Off: order by ordinary melee and crowd only.
